The API questions for Milestone 1b, Cohen–Bergstresser silicon. In the third
round Claude asks whether the pseudopotential interface should follow the
wording `CLAUDE.md` then had, a callable returning both a local and a nonlocal
part. Mads-Peter leaves the round unanswered and says why: the consequences of
either choice are not foreseeable from the question.

The reply is the explanation that should have come with the question: what the
two parts of a pseudopotential are, why they cannot share one signature, and
what each option would cost later. The decision then takes one line.

What came of it: the pseudopotential paragraph in `CLAUDE.md` was rewritten
to describe the interface chosen here, and Claude now explains the consequences
of each option before asking an API question. The physics is in the
[1b theory post](../theory/01b_cohen_bergstresser.qmd).
